artifact: Runtime Verification, End-to-End Formal Verification of the Ethereum 2.0 Deposit Contract (Vyper implementation, v0.10.0), https://github.com/runtimeverification/verified-smart-contracts/tree/master/deposit (deposit-formal-verification.pdf); directory now marked DEPRECATED
property: The Vyper-compiled bytecode of deposit contract v0.10.0 satisfies the formal bytecode specification (incremental Merkle tree correctness, ABI behavior).
model: Bytecode produced by the custom Vyper compiler build 1761-HOTFIX-v0.1.0-beta.13, under KEVM semantics.
assumptions: the verified bytecode is what gets deployed
the exact hotfix compiler build is used to regenerate it
deployed: Not deployed: the contract was reimplemented in Solidity over concerns about the Vyper compiler and re-verified; mainnet runs the Solidity version (Sourcify: solc 0.6.11).
gap: The proof holds only for bytecode from one custom Vyper hotfix build; verifying bytecode rather than source is what exposed Vyper compiler bugs (e.g. a non-ABI-conforming bytes[8] return) that source-level reasoning would have missed, and the verified Vyper artifact is not what was deployed at all.
